newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks edge up on gains weighted scrips.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks edge up on gains weighted scrips.

text.p: Dhaka stocks survived a mid session selling pressure and closed slightly up on gains by some select food and weighted shares, brokers said.
"The market was more or less under correction. But gains by few weighted scrips pushed the index up," said broker S. Ahmed.

Dhaka Stock Exchange benchmark index rose 2.06 points of 0.12 percent up at 1,665 on a turnover of 149.4 million taka. Of the 102 issues traded, 50 ended up, 50 closed down and two unchanged. Bangladesh Toabacco gained 5.44 taka to 278.89, Dhaka Fisheries rose 212.45 to 845.14 and Beximco Pharma lost 6.7 to 156.32. -- Dhaka Newsroom 880-2-506363
